items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He kind of resembled Nick as we used to pass for brothers.

ctx.x: Well, I think of it. Did you ever see a picture of Chris Kelly? I've never seen a picture of him. That's why I didn't know what he looked like even.
He kind of resembled Nick as we used to pass for brothers.
Was he, he wasn't as big as you though I bet was he? Yeah. Was he? Well, I didn't know he was tall.
